data.narrative:
Foundry Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Adarsh Kulkarni that has raised $19M to date. The comparable universe consists of 1 public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and 8 private peers in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics.

Given the early stage and fragmented peer set, only one valuation method yielded reliable results. Stage-progression analysis, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A advancement, values Foundry at $48M, using the $19M total raised as a proxy for current valuation. A peer-median approach was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within tight valuation tiers—only 1 same-stage peer was identified, falling short of the minimum 3-point threshold required for robust median estimation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $40M to $55M, centered at $48M. This single-method result should be weighted with caution given data constraints. Key uncertainties include the limited peer universe at Seed stage in this sector, the absence of recent comparable transaction data at similar valuations, and the strength of Foundry's current financial metrics relative to peers. Additional conviction would require either expanded comparable data or detailed revenue/unit economics from the company itself.
